office_does: A Court of Appeals judge hears appeals from superior courts; Division 1, District 2 judges are elected by Snohomish County voters to six-year terms.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Judge Linda Coburn, on the Court of Appeals since 2021, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Court of Appeals judge since 2021 and former Edmonds Municipal Court judge and Snohomish County public defender, running unopposed.
highlights: Court of Appeals judge since 2021; Edmonds Municipal Court judge until 2021 [S1]
Former Snohomish County public defender and law clerk at the Court of Appeals and Snohomish County Superior Court [S1]
Member of the Supreme Court's Minority and Justice Commission; Judicial College faculty [S1]
